KYC application processing automation

Automated the triage of KYC applications into Accept or Review, so reviewers spend their time on the cases that need judgment.

  • 46% less manual review time
  • Automation
  • Operations
  • KYC

The problem

Every KYC (Know Your Customer) application went through manual review, including the clear-cut ones.

What I did

  • Defined an automation that auto-classifies each submission as Accept or Review.
  • Worked with operations to agree on what makes a submission safe to accept automatically.

The outcome

  • 46% less manual review time
